scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py migrate --noinput
scripts.dev: pnpm db:migrate && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c yellow,magenta,blue "uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000" "uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py run_local_worker" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:api: pnpm db:migrate && uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm db:migrate && uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py run_local_worker
scripts.test: uv run --package linkedin-api python apps/api/manage.py test login_api && uv run --package linkedin-cli pytest apps/cli/tests/unit
